results.title: Accounting the Life Cycle Carbon Footprint for TOD Project
results.content: # Research Article Accounting the life cycle carbon footprint for TOD project: An example from the China SH TOD project. Constructed a carbon footprint accounting model for the whole life cycle. Proposed a calculation method for traffic carbon emission reduction. Proposed an energy carbon emission calculation model for operation phase. ## Abstract. Conducting carbon footprint research on TOD from a whole life cycle perspective holds profound significance for achieving the Dual Carbon Goals. This study constructs five carbon footprint calculation models based on life cycle assessment theory. Setting four residential travel scenario assumptions thoroughly examines the whole life cycle carbon emissions of China SH TOD project and the carbon reduction achieved through transportation during the operation phase. Compared to the continuous increase in carbon footprint observed after the operation of traditional residential and commercial projects, the carbon reduction effect is notably significant. These findings provide recommendations for energy conservation, carbon reduction, and sustainable development in TOD projects. ## Graphical abstract.
